embeddingContract: one active ZotQuery Search model shared by PDF chunks and Note segments; verified equivalent endpoints retain the indexed cache identity
answerViewer: rendered Markdown by default; editable source toggle; original Markdown export
markdownParser: marked 17.0.5 lexer; allowlisted DOM construction; no raw HTML execution or automatic remote images
modelConfigurationUI: ZotQuery preferences only; existing credentials and settings retained
oneClickResearch: prepare evidence session automatically, then invoke model tool research and writing; no full-library rebuild
llmSecrets: Zotero login manager; never ordinary preferences
llmCredentialWrites: await addLoginAsync for new keys; modifyLogin in place for replacements; UI awaits persistence
llmGatePolicy: persisted gate controls verified vs clearly labeled limited model answer; audit never replaces answer
llmAnswerFlow: tool research with bounded continuation, then a separate model writing pass using source evidence; audit panel and answer export are separate
llmMarkdownTemplate: optional user-imported .md file; template-free generation supported; no bundled Markdown output template; untrusted format-only context
